title: Industrial Design Intern – Product Design Cabin
note: Aircraft cabin design; needs current enrollment, apply by Nov 20.

facts.summary: Six-month paid internship with Airbus's cabin product design team in Hamburg, helping shape future aircraft cabin concepts.
facts.duties: Develop and present early cabin design concepts in 2D and 3D; help integrate concepts into workable cabin solutions with engineers; explore sustainable materials and processes; collaborate across the design department.
facts.requirements: Current ID/product/transportation design student; Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign plus Blender, Alias or Rhino; grasp of form, ergonomics and manufacturing; strong presentation skills.
facts.apply: Apply on Airbus Workday (canApply true, posting end date Nov 20, 2026) with cover letter, CV, transcripts and enrollment certificate.
